verdict.rationale: The evidence only says the App API can be used to "fetch data" and that the MCP server and CLI can "read workspace data" or report on message performance. None of it documents per-person engagement history (which messages were sent to a contact, and whether they opened or clicked) through the API. Generic data-fetching and aggregate performance reporting are adjacent capabilities and do not establish this one.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-person engagement history — what was sent, opened, clicked — through the API for any contact
